set.display.drawing.help: How the scan is drawn. Auto: SuperSplat's stochastic drawing in a desktop browser with WebGPU, the classic sorted drawing on phones, tablets and without WebGPU, unless the scene's link or its owner asks for the other. Stochastic skips sorting the splats and leaves a fine grain. Sorted is the classic, smooth drawing. A link with ?stochastic (or ?stochastic=0) is obeyed when a scene opens; a choice made here while flying wins for that scene. Stochastic needs WebGPU in a desktop browser.
set.display.budget.help: How many million splats the scan may draw at most. Auto takes the link's ?budget=, the scene owner's choice, or what suits this device. A link's ?budget= is obeyed when a scene opens; a choice made here while flying wins for that scene. More splats are sharper and slower; the quality governor still lowers it when frames are missed.
